question: The average of the squares of the first 48 natural numbers is
solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ca81259519cadfb2d5350673c220e419e60378e9770ad26512fc8e826a8d93f1.png] __Shortcut Trick__

The average of the squares of the first n natural numbers is directly given by the formula (n + 1)(2n + 1) ÷ 6.

Substitute n = 48 in the formula.

Average = (48 + 1)(2 × 48 + 1) ÷ 6 = (49 × 97) ÷ 6

Average = 4753 ÷ 6 ≈ 792.17

**∴ The correct answer is 792.17.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c76c13ba2d2ab46b47f8a931ae621dac081a0cb266b142dc23f58659fac4a466.png] **__Alternate Method__**

**Given:**

Total count of natural numbers (n) = 48

**Formula Used:**

Sum of squares of first n natural numbers = n(n + 1)(2n + 1) ÷ 6

Average = Sum ÷ n = (n + 1)(2n + 1) ÷ 6

 Average = (n+1)(2n+1)/6

**Calculations:**

⇒ Average = (48 + 1)(2 × 48 + 1) ÷ 6

⇒ Average = (49 × 97) ÷ 6

⇒ Average = 792.1666...

⇒ Average ≈ 792.17

**∴ The correct answer is 792.17.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

Average of First 'n' Natural Numbers

The sum of the first 'n' natural numbers is n(n + 1) ÷ 2, so dividing by 'n' directly gives the average as (n + 1) ÷ 2.

Average of Cubes of First 'n' Natural Numbers

The sum of the cubes is [n(n + 1) ÷ 2]², which simplifies the average of the cubes to n(n + 1)² ÷ 4.

Average of First 'n' Even & Odd Numbers

The average of the first 'n' even natural numbers is strictly (n + 1). Meanwhile, the average of the first 'n' odd natural numbers is simply n.
